recast.wrong_target: Phasing psi-x against e^{-i gamma* log x} makes the star EF term CONSTANT (-1/rho*), not oscillatory. Star alone cannot produce limsup +infty of that real part; Self loglog already cancelled the pure star loglog in S_X.
recast.correct_PAO_core: After star removal, need phase-aligned lower bound on the contribution of (i) other zeros, and/or (ii) the prime side residual int (psi-x)_* x^{-rho*-1}/log x, equivalent to large values of sum_{n<=X} Lambda(n) n^{-rho*}/log n (Form C).

single_gamma_lock.object: sum_n Lambda(n) n^{-beta*} n^{-i gamma*} / log n = sum Lambda(n)/(n^{beta*} log n) e^{-i gamma* log n}
single_gamma_lock.mechanism: align prime angles {gamma* log p / 2pi} mod 1 — but gamma* fixed, free variable is which primes/n or the cutoff X
single_gamma_lock.diophantine: For fixed gamma*, the sequence {gamma* log p / 2pi} is like a Kronecker sequence in p. Unlike free t, we cannot choose t to align all log p. We choose X or a set of n. This is multiplicative resonance in the n-aspect at FIXED frequency — harder than t-aspect.
single_gamma_lock.status: OPEN — no classical theorem gives limsup |S_X(rho*)|=infty off the line without RH-scale input

design_template_AFE_Moll.step2: Replace arg zeta by arg(F + chi G + R) from AFE at the evaluation path

bookkeeping_lemmas_template.statement: Let gamma be a path from 1/2+it to sigma+it (sigma>1/2) avoiding zeros. Let gamma' be the reflected path from 1/2-it to (1-sigma)-it (or conjugate-reflected as needed). Then Delta_gamma arg zeta = Delta_gamma arg chi + Delta_{gamma_refl} arg zeta, with arg chi explicitly estimable.
bookkeeping_lemmas_template.status: standard FE consequence — bookkeeping, not a phase lower bound engine
